title: Groups and transforms
narration: Groups may carry translate, scale and rotate transforms, and every allowlisted shape appears here once: path, line, circle, ellipse, rect, polyline, polygon and text.

elements.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g transform="translate(10,10)"><path d="M0 0 L40 0 Q 50 20 40 40 Z" stroke="accent1" fill="none"/><line x1="0" y1="50" x2="40" y2="50" stroke="muted"/></g><g transform="translate(60,10) scale(0.5)"><circle cx="40" cy="40" r="30" stroke="accent2" fill="none"/><ellipse cx="40" cy="40" rx="20" ry="10" stroke="accent3" fill="none"/></g><g transform="rotate(10, 60, 90)"><rect x="20" y="80" width="30" height="20" stroke="accent4" fill="none"/></g><polyline points="70,70 80,90 90,70 100,90" stroke="accent5" fill="none"/><polygon points="70,100 90,100 80,115" stroke="chalk" fill="none"/><text x="60" y="65" font-size="7" text-anchor="middle" fill="chalk">all eight shapes in one</text></svg>
